clm_name_ambiguity_5d077364.value: A distinct 'Motasar' village exists in Kolayat tehsil, Bikaner (pop. 443, gram panchayat Gadiyala) — not in Lunkaransar tehsil.
clm_name_ambiguity_5d077364.statement_hi: बीकानेर की कोलायत तहसील में एक अलग 'मोटासर' गांव है, जो लूणकरणसर तहसील में नहीं है।
clm_name_ambiguity_5d077364.statement_en: A separate Motasar village exists in Kolayat tehsil of Bikaner district, distinct from the Lunkaransar/Mahajan area.

evidence.text: located in Kolayat Tehsil of Bikaner district... Gadiyala is the gram panchayat of Motasar village

clm_current_administrative_status_edded8.statement_en: Motasar does not appear as an independent village in the present-day Lunkaransar tehsil village list; the area is covered by the single 'Mahajan Fieldfiring Range' census entry.
